14756-the-man-in-the-twilight.title: The Man In The Twilight
14756-the-man-in-the-twilight.creator: Ridgwell Cullum
14756-the-man-in-the-twilight.description: A book by Ridgwell Cullum. They sat squarely gazing into each other's eyes. Bat Marker had only one mood to express. It was a mood that suggested determination to fight to a finish, to fight with the last ounce of strength, the last gasp of breath. He was sitting at the desk, opposite his friend and employer, Leslie Standing, and his small grey eyes were shining coldly under his shaggy, black brows. His broad shoulders were squared aggressively.

arxiv-2011-13010.title: Quantum Correlations in Neutrino Oscillation: Coherence and Entanglement
arxiv-2011-13010.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the quantum correlations, coherence and entanglement, in neutrino oscillation. We find that the l 1 l_{1} -norm as a coherence measure is equal to sum of the three possible concurrences for measuring the entanglement among different flavor modes which were calculated in the paper by (M. Blasone et al., Europhys. Lett., 112 , 20007).

arxiv-2012-14405.title: Shape-based Feature Engineering for Solar Flare Prediction
arxiv-2012-14405.creator: Varad Deshmukh, Thomas Berger, James Meiss, Elizabeth Bradley
arxiv-2012-14405.description: Abstract Solar flares are caused by magnetic eruptions in active regions (ARs) on the surface of the sun. These events can have significant impacts on human activity, many of which can be mitigated with enough advance warning from good forecasts.

arxiv-2102-10292.title: Preparation of superconducting thin films of infinite-layer nickelate Nd 0.8 Sr 0.2 NiO 2
arxiv-2102-10292.creator: Qiang Gao 1 , Yuchen Zhao 1,2 , Xingjiang Zhou 1,2,3,4,∗ , and Zhihai Zhu 1,2,∗
arxiv-2102-10292.description: Abstract The recent observation of superconductivity in thin films of infinite-layer nickelate Nd 0.8 Sr 0.2 NiO 2 has received considerable attention. Despite the many efforts to understand the superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates, a consensus on the underlying mechanism for the superconductivity has yet to be reached, partly owing to the challenges with the material synthesis.

arxiv-2107-00537.title: About Evaluation Metrics for Contextual Uplift Modeling
arxiv-2107-00537.creator: C. RENAUDIN, M. MARTIN
arxiv-2107-00537.description: Abstract . In this tech report we discuss the evaluation problem of contextual uplift modeling from the causal inference point of view. More particularly, we instantiate the individual treatment effect (ITE) estimation, and its evaluation counterpart. First, we unify two well studied fields: the statistical ITE approach and its observational counterpart based on uplift study.

arxiv-2108-01182.title: Underreporting of errors in NLG output, and what to do about it
arxiv-2108-01182.creator: Emiel van Miltenburg, Miruna Clinciu, Ondřej Dušek, Dimitra Gkatzia, Stephanie Inglis, Leo Leppänen, Saad Mahamood, Emma Manning, Stephanie Schoch, Craig Thomson, and Luou Wen, [3ex] Tilburg University, Edinburgh Centre for Robotics, Heriot-Watt University, University of Edinburgh, Charles Universit
arxiv-2108-01182.description: Abstract We observe a severe under-reporting of the different kinds of errors that Natural Language Generation systems make. This is a problem, because mistakes are an important indicator of where systems should still be improved. If authors only report overall performance metrics, the research community is left in the dark about the specific weaknesses that are exhibited by ‘state-of-the-art’ research.

arxiv-2204-03082.title: Instance Segmentation of Unlabeled Modalities via Cyclic Segmentation GAN
arxiv-2204-03082.creator: Leander Lauenburg 1, 2], Zudi Lin 1*, Ruihan Zhang 3, Márcia dos Santos 4, Siyu Huang 1, Ignacio Arganda-Carreras 5, 6, 7], Edward S. Boyden 3, 8], Hanspeter Pfister 1, Donglai Wei 9
arxiv-2204-03082.description: Abstract Instance segmentation for unlabeled imaging modalities is a challenging but essential task as collecting expert annotation can be expensive and time-consuming. Existing works segment a new modality by either deploying a pre-trained model optimized on diverse training data or conducting domain translation and image segmentation as two independent steps.

arxiv-2204-10077.title: Le rang des tissus de Nakai.
arxiv-2204-10077.creator: Jean-Paul Dufour et Daniel Lehmann
arxiv-2204-10077.description: Abstract According to Alain Hénaut, a planar 4-web is called Nakai’s web if the cross-ratio of the tangents to the four foliations at each point is constant and if it has no hexagonal 3-subweb. We prove that Nakai’s webs have rank 0 or 1. We give examples with rank 1 and present a universal way to build such examples.

arxiv-2210-08202.title: IBL-NeRF: Image-Based Lighting Formulation of Neural Radiance Fields Volume: 42 Issue: 7
arxiv-2210-08202.creator: Changwoon Choi ∗ 1 Juhyeon Kim ∗ 1,2 Young Min Kim † 1 1 Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University 2 Department of Computer Science, Dartmouth College
arxiv-2210-08202.description: Abstract We propose IBL-NeRF, which decomposes the neural radiance fields (NeRF) of large-scale indoor scenes into intrinsic components. Recent approaches further decompose the baked radiance of the implicit volume into intrinsic components such that one can partially approximate the rendering equation.

arxiv-2303-16055.title: Augmented Reality Remote Operation of Dual Arm Manipulators in Hot Boxes
arxiv-2303-16055.creator: Frank Regal, Young Soo Park, Jerry Nolan, and Mitch Pryor
arxiv-2303-16055.description: Abstract I INTRODUCTION In nuclear isotope and chemistry laboratories, hot cells and gloveboxes provide scientists with a controlled and safe environment to perform experiments [ 1 ] . Working on experiments in these isolated containment cells requires scientists to be physically present. For hot cell work, scientists manipulate equipment and radioactive material inside through a bilateral mechanical control mechanism.

arxiv-2306-03966.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yue Samuel Lu, Nir Mandelker, S. Peng Oh, Avishai Dekel, Frank C. van den Bosch, Volker Springel, Daisuke Nagai, Freeke van de Voort. arxiv-2410-01980.creator: A. G. Silva, R. B. Pontes, M. Boldrin, H. V. S. Pessoni, L. S. I. Veiga, J. R. Jesus, H. Fabrelli, A. R. C. Gonzaga, E. M. Bittar, L. Bufaiçal

arxiv-2503-09871.title: LuciBot: Automated Robot Policy Learning from Generated Videos
arxiv-2503-09871.creator: Xiaowen Qiu, Yian Wang, Jiting Cai, Zhehuan Chen, Chunru Lin, Tsun-Hsuan Wang, Chuang Gan
arxiv-2503-09871.description: Abstract Automatically generating training supervision for embodied tasks is crucial, as manual designing is tedious and not scalable. While prior works use large language models (LLMs) or vision-language models (VLMs) to generate rewards, these approaches are largely limited to simple tasks with well-defined rewards, such as pick-and-place.

arxiv-2503-24038.title: Giant counter-rotating oscillations on the attosecond timescale
arxiv-2503-24038.creator: Jakob Nicolai Bruhnke, Edvin Olofsson, Axel Stenquist, Jan Marcus Dahlström † {}^{\text{\dagger}}
arxiv-2503-24038.description: Abstract We predict an unexplored type of ultrastrong coupling between atoms and intense ultraviolet light that leads to giant population oscillations on the attosecond timescale. These counter-rotating oscillations can be of similar amplitude as the elementary femtosecond Rabi oscillations between the two strongly coupled states.

We focus on Langevin dynamics with a positive temperature β − 1 \beta^{-1} , i.e.

arxiv-2507-15315.title: On Repetitive Finite Automata with Translucent Words
arxiv-2507-15315.creator: František Mráz, Friedrich Otto
arxiv-2507-15315.description: Abstract We introduce and study the repetitive variants of the deterministic and the nondeterministic finite automaton with translucent words (DFAwtw and NFAwtw). On seeing the right sentinel, a repetitive NFAwtw need not halt immediately, accepting or rejecting, but it may change into another state and continue with its computation.

arxiv-2509-22607.title: Summation Formulas for Harmonic Maass Forms
arxiv-2509-22607.creator: Nikolaos Diamantis, Joshua Pimm
arxiv-2509-22607.description: Abstract . In a previous work [ BDG+25 ] , a summation formula for harmonic Maass forms of polynomial growth was established. In this note, we use the theory of L L -series of harmonic Maass forms to state and prove a summation formula for such forms without any restrictions on their growth.

arxiv-2602-24007.title: Inference-time optimization for experiment-grounded protein ensemble generation
arxiv-2602-24007.creator: Advaith Maddipatla, Anar Rzayev, Marco Pegoraro, Martin Pacesa, Paul Schanda, Ailie Marx, Sanketh Vedula, Alex Bronstein
arxiv-2602-24007.description: Abstract Protein function relies on dynamic conformational ensembles, yet current generative models like AlphaFold3 ( Abramson et al. 2024 ) often fail to produce ensembles that match experimental data. Recent experiment-guided generators attempt to address this by steering the reverse diffusion process. However, these methods are limited by fixed sampling horizons and sensitivity to initialization, often yielding thermodynamically implausible results.

pmc-10692888.title: Determinants of Adolescent Sexual and Reproductive Health in Sub-Saharan Africa: Protocol for an Umbrella Review
pmc-10692888.creator: Mona Ziba Ghadirian, Khalid Omer, Anne Cockcroft
pmc-10692888.description: BackgroundAdolescents are a large proportion of the population in sub-Saharan Africa and face multiple risks to their health and well-being. Prior systematic reviews have focused on specific adolescent sexual and reproductive health outcomes such as teen pregnancies, HIV/AIDS, and sexually transmitted diseases.

pmc-11333582.title: Postsynaptic lncRNA Sera/Pkm2 pathway orchestrates the transition from social competition to rank by remodeling the neural ensemble in mPFC
pmc-11333582.creator: Ling-Shuang Zhu, Chuan Lai, Chao-Wen Zhou, Hui-Yang Chen, Zhi-Qiang Liu, Ziyuan Guo, Hengye Man, Hui-Yun Du, Youming Lu, Feng Hu, Zhiye Chen, Kai Shu, Ling-Qiang Zhu, Dan Liu
pmc-11333582.description: Individuals’ continuous success in competitive interactions with conspecifics strongly affects their social hierarchy. Medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) is the key brain region mediating both social competition and hierarchy. However, the molecular regulatory mechanisms underlying the neural ensemble in the mPFC remains unclear.

pmc-12469495.title: Phosphatidic Acid Reverses Obesity Induced by a High-Fat, High-Sugar Diet at the Transcriptional Level
pmc-12469495.creator: Hao Xie, Qian Cheng, Xingyi Tian, Yanlin Liao, Giuseppe Iacomino
pmc-12469495.description: Background: Obesity poses a significant threat to human health and is commonly caused by excessive dietary intake. Phosphatidic acid (PA) is one of the simplest diacylglycerol phospholipids, serving as a crucial precursor for the synthesis of triglycerides and other complex phospholipids. PA is also an important intermediate product in the process of fat digestion and absorption.

pmc-12565728.title: SEPoolConvNeXt: A Deep Learning Framework for Automated Classification of Neonatal Brain Development Using T1- and T2-Weighted MRI
pmc-12565728.creator: Gulay Maçin, Melahat Poyraz, Zeynep Akca Andi, Nisa Yıldırım, Burak Taşcı, Gulay Taşcı, Sengul Dogan, Turker Tuncer, Eros Montin, Giuseppe Carluccio
pmc-12565728.description: Background/Objectives: The neonatal and infant periods represent a critical window for brain development, characterized by rapid and heterogeneous processes such as myelination and cortical maturation. Accurate assessment of these changes is essential for understanding normative trajectories and detecting early abnormalities. While conventional MRI provides valuable insights, automated classification remains challenging due to overlapping developmental stages and sex-specific variability.

pmc-12590746.title: Application effectiveness analysis of diversified teaching combined with virtual simulation experiments in standardized training for orthopedic residents
pmc-12590746.creator: Xiao Liu, Yunfei Yuan, Feifei Zhou
pmc-12590746.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the application effect of combining diversified teaching with virtual simulation experiments in the standardized training for orthopedic residents.MethodsThirty residents from Peking University Third Hospital were selected and randomly divided into three groups (n = 10 per group): the Virtual Simulation group, the Medical Manikin group, and the Virtual Simulation combined with Simulator group (the Combined Training group). All participants received online pre-study and 3-h offline theoretical teaching.

pmc-12692756.title: Beyond BMI: Metabolic Signatures of Obstructive Coronary Artery Disease in a Sudanese Cohort
pmc-12692756.creator: Ramaze F Elhakeem, Mohamed F Lutfi, Abdelkarim A Abdrabo, Ahmed B Ali, Mohamed Y Sukkar, Attila Nemes
pmc-12692756.description: Background: CAD continues to be a major global cause of morbidity and mortality, but its metabolic underpinnings in African populations remain poorly characterized. Conventional predictors such as body mass index (BMI) and insulin resistance markers may not fully capture risk in these settings.

pmc-12838365.title: Hydrogel Microsphere-Based Alveolar Models for Toxicity Assessment and Pathogen Infection Studies
pmc-12838365.creator: Chang Zhou, Jingyuan Ji, Meiling Fu, Yuhui Tang, Yuan Liu, Yang Zheng, Yuan Pang
pmc-12838365.description: The alveolar epithelium plays a critical role in respiratory function, facilitating air exchange and serving as a barrier against inhaled pathogens. Its unique three-dimensional architecture, in which epithelial cells grow on spherical alveolar structures, significantly increases the surface area-to-volume ratio for efficient gas exchange but poses challenges for in vitro reconstruction.
